items.html: The Ayin is also named after SAG, like the above AHP. This is because when there were the above three phases, which are AHP, which are the tastes, their SAG there was in the phase of HaVaYaH, which is SAG: Yod-Vav-Dalet [pronounced Yod], Hey-Yod [pronounced Hey], Vav-Aleph-Vav [pronounced Vav], Hey-Yod [Hey]. However, in the Ayin, which is the phase of dots, it is SAG of three times EKYE [Aleph-Hey-Yod-Hey], which is also SAG [63] in Gematria, and this is the SAG that is in the Ayin.
